name: Imperially Commissioned Set of Ink Sticks with Images and Poems of Famous West Lake Sites
aliases: 御製西湖名勝圖詩硃錠
material: Molded ink in yellow, blue, black, green, red, brown, white, and gold
summary: Each ink stick depicts one of the Ten Scenes of the West Lake on one side, and a corresponding imperial poem on the other, composed on emperor Qianlong’s fifth southern inspection tour in 1780.
